Opening.description_en: Retrieves the opening remarks and questions for web search Q&A, including statically configured opening remarks and questions, as well as dynamic real-time trending topics
Opening.description_zh: 联网问答开场白接口，用于获取静态配置的开场白、开场问题，以及获取动态实时的热点资讯

QaChat.description_en: Performs web-search Q&A (OpenAI-compatible, supports multi-turn context and follow-up recommendations, SSE streaming, and JSON non-streaming)
QaChat.description_zh: 联网问答（OpenAI 兼容，支持多轮上下文与追问推荐，SSE 流式 / JSON 非流式）

WebSearch.description_en:
Initiates real-time searches on the Internet and retrieves a structured list of web page results. You can integrate this API into scenarios such as AI Q&A, content aggregation, public sentiment monitoring, and knowledge enhancement to provide real-time, multi-source external knowledge support for your applications.

Two search modes are provided:
Pro: suitable for complex queries, providing more relevant and authoritative results, and supporting global sources.
Lite: suitable for daily queries, with faster response and lower costs
WebSearch.description_zh:
联网搜索 API 允许您向互联网发起实时搜索，并获取结构化的网页结果列表。您可以将其集成到 AI 问答、内容聚合、舆情监控、知识增强等场景中，为您的应用提供实时、多源的外部知识支撑。

提供 2 种搜索模式：
Pro 版，适合复杂问题搜索，提供更相关、更权威的结果，支持搜索全球信源
Lite 版，适合日常问题搜索，响应更快、成本更低
